issue.title: Reverse project conversion leaves the prerequisite's BLOCKS entry pointing at the trashed project's ^prj
issue.description:
Repo: bob-plugins (linked), master 8406ebb.

`node --test --test-name-pattern="forward conversion carries a Depends-On line" scripts/test-navigation-hotkeys-forward-promotion.cjs` fails 2/2 runs at master, and passes with `plugins/bob-navigation-hotkeys` checked out at 108bedf (bob-cli-7e.7). So 8406ebb (bob-cli-7e.8, "mirror remaining Depends-On writers onto BLOCKS", which routes project conversion through the shared BLOCKS seam) introduced it.

The failing assertion is line 734: `assert.doesNotMatch(restored, /Work_ship#\^prj/)`. After forward conversion (Ship it → `Work_ship.md` `^prj`) and then reverse conversion (back into `Areas/Work.md` as `^ship`, with `Work_ship.md` trashed), the restored `Areas/Work.md` reads:

```
- [ ] #task Prereq [id:: Areas__Work__prereq] ^prereq
	- 🧱 **BLOCKS:** [[Work_ship#^prj]]
- [?] #task Ship it [created::2026-10-13] [id:: Areas__Work__ship] [dependsOn:: Areas__Work__prereq] ^ship
	- ⛓️ **DEPENDS ON:** [[#^prereq]]
```

The prerequisite's BLOCKS entry still points at the trashed project's `^prj` instead of the restored `[[#^ship]]`. The forward path re-keys the entry, but the reverse path does not. That leaves a dangling BLOCKS link until the next reconcile. Either the reverse conversion's BLOCKS follow-up must re-key old → new identity (same note as the prerequisite, so it belongs in the parent write per docs/task-dependencies.md §14 writers), or the test's expectation needs an explicit contract decision.

Proposed by bob-cli-7c.8 (note #2, "no existing tracking bead found"); filed by the bob-cli-7c land agent. Not caused by bob-cli-7c: no successor code is involved, and it bisects to a bob-cli-7e commit (that epic is closed).
